content.title: Clinical Practice Guidelines Committee 2022-2024 - Declarations of Interest (page snapshot)
content.notes: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year. Calls cover development period up to and including 2023.
